Container.Name: Hikidashi-Server-Worker
Container.Overview: The Hikidashi server's own worker: it downloads each new reel and its thumbnail, and embeds reels for search by meaning. Every Hikidashi install needs it, beside the Hikidashi container.[br][br]Give it exactly the same Data path as Hikidashi: they share the database there, and nothing else. No port: it serves nothing, but it does reach Instagram and downloads the embedder once.
Container.Requires: Hikidashi, on the same Data path.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Exactly Hikidashi's Data path. A pool, never /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Stages
Config.Description: Of enrich and embed. The other stages need the worker image.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: OpenAI key
Config.Description: Optional. The server's own OpenAI key, for hosted AI (docs/operation.md#hosted-ai). Also settable, encrypted, on the server's Account → AI providers. Nothing is sent until the switch there is turned on.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: Groq key
Config.Description: Optional. The server's own Groq key: free Whisper transcription.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: monthly budget
Config.Description: USD a month for the server's API. Required before it can be turned on; it turns itself off when reached.

Config.Name: Hosted AI: secret key
Config.Description: Encrypts the API keys saved in the database. Empty: a random one in /data/secret.key. The same here and in the server.

Config.Name: Unload after
Config.Description: Seconds with no work before the embedder is unloaded.

Config.Name: Log to syslog
Config.Description: Also send the log to a syslog server, as udp://192.168.1.10:514 (Unraid's own, under Settings, Syslog Server). Empty: off.

Config.Name: Log to Loki
Config.Description: Also push the log to Loki, as http://192.168.1.10:3100. Empty: off.

Config.Name: Loki token
Config.Description: A bearer token for Loki, if it asks for one.
